Russia holds parliamentary elections amid wartime clampdown

Russia concluded its parliamentary elections on Sunday, with projections indicating that the United Russia party will retain control. The election process was characterized by a significant suppression of opposition and dissent. Voting also took place in Ukrainian territories that Russia has annexed, actions that Ukraine has condemned.
